purpose: Condition only the native raw PDC bridge initializer using a raw-observable Doppler-WLS velocity integral; do not change the P+D+temporal objective or any numeric parameter.

candidate_contract.name: native_raw_pdc_bridge_integrated_wls_position_seed_v1
candidate_contract.anchor: the first finite native SPP ECEF position already present in the in-memory raw problem
candidate_contract.valid_velocity: use an existing valid raw-observable Doppler-WLS ECEF velocity and clock-rate estimate only; no new solve or truth feature
candidate_contract.position_update: for a continuous interval dt>0 and dt<=1.5 s, p[i]=p[i-1]+0.5*dt*(v[i-1]+v[i]) when both velocities are available
candidate_contract.invalid_wls_interval: if the current WLS estimate is invalid but the preceding velocity and interval remain valid, use p[i]=p[i-1]+dt*v[i-1]; otherwise use the original finite per-epoch native SPP seed and reset the integrated chain
candidate_contract.clock_jump_or_gap: never integrate across a clock jump, non-positive/non-finite dt, or dt>1.5 s; use the original per-epoch SPP seed and reset the chain
candidate_contract.safety: integrated position must be finite and have ECEF norm in (1e6,1e7) m; otherwise use the original finite SPP seed, and fail closed if that is invalid
candidate_contract.velocity_seed_handoff: valid WLS velocity/clock-rate remains the bridge state initializer; invalid WLS remains the historical zero initializer
candidate_contract.clock_bias_initialization: unchanged source native SPP clock bias in metres

unchanged_objective_and_parameters.state: per-epoch ECEF position, five clock groups, ECEF velocity, receiver clock rate

predeclared_structural_gate.if_failed: seal No-Go; do not open truth or rerun the Phase24 matrix

evaluation.phase24_matrix: not rerun until the three-route structural gate passes
evaluation.next_action: implement this initializer-only contract, add synthetic integration/fallback tests, run the three raw routes, and seal the result
